hero.badge: Gamification that works for the marketplace
hero.title: Noti the raccoon grows from what you do on Avito
hero.subtitle: Not a "feed me" button, but a mirror of your activity: post a listing and your pet eats and grows, sell an item and it celebrates, add a favorite and it cheers up, drop by today and your streak lives on.
hero.note: Sign up in a minute — your pet hatches after the first action

loop.title: How it works
loop.subtitle: A real action on the marketplace — an instant reaction from your pet

levels.title: 15 levels
levels.text: Fixed experience thresholds, a reward on every level and progress to the next one always in sight

streak.title: Streaks with freezes
streak.text: Check in daily to keep your streak. Miss a day and a freeze you earned earlier saves it

rewards.title: Promo code rewards
rewards.text: Discounts on promotion, delivery and Autoteka. Each code is signed, bound to you and used once

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.text: Top players and your closest rivals — see who to chase and how much experience is left

realtime.title: Realtime over WebSocket
realtime.text: Hatching, experience gains and level ups reach the screen without reloading the page

summary.title: Daily pet summary
summary.text: A first-person recap: what changed, what you earned and what your listings are missing

targeted.title: Targeted actions, not idle clicks
targeted.text: The loop rewards listings, content quality and completed deals instead of mindless tapping

quality.title: Better listings
quality.text: The pet points out what a listing lacks — which directly lifts marketplace conversion

retention.title: Retention
retention.text: Check-in streaks and decaying pet stats give a reason to open the app every day

monetization.title: Monetization
monetization.text: Rewards introduce paid marketplace services through a free trial

cta.title: Get your own Noti in a minute
cta.text: Sign up, post your first listing — and watch the egg hatch in real time
